requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:10 matches the contract signature. Line 15 is a no-op for a null or blank URL, before any HTTP call. Line 32 uses `Http::timeout(5)->post($webhookUrl, ['content' => $content])`. Lines 19-25 build title, message and `key=value` lines. Lines 27-29 truncate multibyte-safely to exactly 1800 characters. Redaction covers sensitive keys (lines 117-133, including api_key, api-key and apikey via normalization), Bearer values (line 94) and recursive nesting rendered as JSON (lines 64-67, 101-113). Non-2xx responses (lines 36-39) and exceptions (lines 41-44) are logged at error level and the URL is scrubbed. config/logging.php:57 changes the LOG_STACK default to daily, lines 76-82 add the audit channel (daily driver, logs/audit.log, level info, days 90), and no discord channel is added. config/services.php:31-33 adds the webhook config. .env.example and phpunit.xml:32 have the new keys. The `daily` channel is not in the diff, so the required 14-day/LOG_DAILY_DAYS setting is only inferred from the framework default.

conventions.evidence: No tests ship with the change, which breaks 'No production code without a test'. No CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased]. The docs went to docs/ops/logging-and-alerts.md, but conventions.md links to docs/ops/logging.md. The public send() method has no PHPDoc. The new service class is allowed because the task explicitly requires it. The config edits match sibling style (`'replace_placeholders' => true`).

security.evidence: Context values are redacted by key and by Bearer pattern, recursively (DiscordOpsAlert.php:91-115). Failure logs contain only the status (line 37-38) or the scrubbed exception message (line 43, `scrub($e->getMessage(), $webhookUrl)`). Scrubbing is an exact str_replace of the full URL (line 138), so a URL-encoded URL or a bare token in an exception message would get through. Objects with __toString skip the Bearer check (lines 81-83). No user-facing input surface.

tests.evidence: The diff adds no Pest/PHPUnit test files. Nothing covers the no-op, the payload format, truncation, redaction, soft-fail logging, URL scrubbing or the logging config contract. phpunit.xml:32 only pins LOG_STACK.

simplicity.evidence: One class with small private helpers that uses the Http and Log facades directly. renderValue (lines 55-89) is a little verbose: it has two identical json_encode fallbacks and a __toString branch. The nested try/catch (lines 12-52) is defensive but justified by the never-throw requirement.

readability.evidence: Names are clear (renderValue, redactValue, isSensitiveKey, scrub) and methods are focused. Magic numbers 1800 and 5 are inline rather than named constants. The outer catch logs a bare message with no context (line 48). No debug leftovers.

scope.evidence: Every edit serves the task: .env.example, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/logging.php, config/services.php, docs/ops/logging-and-alerts.md and phpunit.xml. Nothing is wired into jobs or handlers, which matches the out-of-scope section.

issues.explanation: The diff has no tests for DiscordOpsAlert or the logging config, which breaks the project's mandatory test-first rule.
The daily channel is not touched in the diff, so the required 14-day/LOG_DAILY_DAYS retention and laravel.log path depend on unshown existing config and cannot be confirmed.
conventions.md links to docs/ops/logging.md, but the guide was written to a different filename, so that link stays broken.
The docs-sync convention requires an [Unreleased] CHANGELOG entry, and none was added.
Scrubbing only replaces the exact full URL string, so a URL-encoded URL or a bare token in an exception message would still be logged.
The public send() method has no PHPDoc, and the 1800 and 5 values would read better as named constants.
renderValue has duplicated json_encode/[unserializable] fallbacks that could be merged.

review.summary: The change adds a well-built DiscordOpsAlert (no-op when the URL is unset, key and Bearer redaction including nested arrays, multibyte truncation to 1800 characters, soft-fail error logging with URL scrubbing). It also adds the audit log channel, switches the stack default to daily, and adds the env keys and an ops decision guide. It meets nearly all functional requirements, but it ships no tests at all, which the project's mandatory test-first convention forbids. It also misses the CHANGELOG entry and the docs/ops/logging.md filename that conventions.md links to, so it needs changes before merging.
